faq.insurance: We accept Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, MetLife and Guardian. We can check your coverage before the visit.
faq.parking: Free parking behind the building; the entrance is on Maple Avenue.
faq.payment: Card, cash, Apple Pay and CareCredit. Payment plans are available for treatments over $500.
faq.cancellation: Please cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Late cancellations may have a $40 fee.
faq.new_patients: New patients are welcome. Please arrive 10 minutes early to fill in a short form.
